## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** a phone or a computer with a browser, and your
  university account (Microsoft Forms at `forms.office.com`). Google Forms
  works in the same way.
- **Time:** about 45 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** read Steps 1–3 and answer their questions: the page
  checks each answer at once. Then do the **Tasks to submit**.
- **The course project starts here.** You choose one service (Step 1). You
  build its form now, its website in Online activity 11, and its post and
  marketing plan in Online activity 12.
- **What you submit:** a link, two screenshots and two letters, on the
  university e-learning platform, before lecture 10.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary digital-service online-form question-type form-response >}}

## Step 1 · Choose the service of your project {.study}

Choose **one** service. All its facts are given: you only build it. Write
its letter in Task 1.

| | Service | Kind | The customer | The questions of its form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | **Study Room**: book the library study room | booking | students | Your name (Text) · Day (Choice: Sunday to Thursday) · Time (Choice: 10:00, 12:00, 14:00) · Number of students (Number) |
| **B** | **Easy Print**: order printing | online form | students | Your name (Text) · What to print (Choice: notes, report, poster) · Pages (Number) · Pick-up day (Date) |
| **C** | **Fix It**: book a phone repair | booking | people with a broken phone | Your name (Text) · Phone (Choice: Android, iPhone) · Problem (Choice: screen, battery, other) · Day (Date) |
| **D** | **Green Bites**: order a lunch box | online form | staff and students | Your name (Text) · Lunch (Choice: chicken, falafel, salad) · Boxes (Number) · Day (Date) |

: The four services of the course project (made up).

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The four services"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="a digital product|Date"}
Which kind of service is Fix It?
:   a booking

    Why: The customer chooses a day for the repair.

In Green Bites, which question type is "Lunch"?
:   Choice

    Why: The customer chooses chicken, falafel or salad.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · Build the form and share its link {.study}

- **New Form**, then the title (the name of your service).
- **+ Add new** for each question: **Choice** (with its options), **Text**,
  **Date**; for a number, Text with **Restrictions › Number**.
- Turn on **Required** for the important questions.
- **Collect responses** gives the **link** (Copy) and a **QR code**.

::: {.callout-note title="Model · The gym booking form"}
The college gym takes bookings online. Its form *Gym booking* has two
questions: *Day* (Date) and *Which time?* (Choice: 10:00, 12:00, 14:00).
The screens below show how it is made and shared.
:::

**In a browser, on a phone or a computer.** The orange numbers show where
to click.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} At `forms.office.com`, click **New Form**. Type the title.](images/forms-new-1.png)

![[1]{.step-n} Click **+ Add new**, then [2]{.step-n} **Choice**. [3]{.step-n} Type the question and the options.](images/forms-question-1.png)

![[1]{.step-n} Click **Collect responses**. [2]{.step-n} Click **Copy**: the link of the form.](images/forms-collect-1.png)
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Build and share"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Rating|Save As"}
Which question type gives options to tap?
:   Choice

    Why: The customer taps one option, so every answer is written the same way.

How do customers open your form?
:   with its link or its QR code

    Why: Collect responses gives the link and the QR code.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · The responses in a sheet {.study}

- Each **response** (one filled-in form) is **one row** of a sheet.
- **Responses** shows how many people answered, with charts.
- **Open results in Excel** opens the sheet: one row for each response.

::: {.callout-note title="Model · Three gym bookings"}
Three students booked the gym. The Responses tab shows **3**; the time
10:00 is the most popular. In Excel the three bookings are rows 2, 3 and 4.
:::

**In a browser.** The orange numbers show where to click.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} Click **Responses**: the number of responses and a chart. [2]{.step-n} Click **Open results in Excel**: one row for each response.](images/forms-responses-1.png)
:::

{{< sim file="sims/form-builder.html" poster="sims/form-builder.png" title="Form Builder: an order form and its sheet" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Responses"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="1|nowhere"}
Five people send the gym form. How many rows of answers are in the sheet?
:   5

    Why: One response is one row.

Where do you see the number of responses?
:   the Responses tab

    Why: Responses shows how many people answered, with charts.
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

### Task 1 · The form of your service

1. Write the letter of your service (Step 1): A, B, C or D.

   {{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

2. In Microsoft Forms, make its form: the title is the name of the
   service, and the four questions of the table, with their types.
3. Copy the link of the form (Collect responses › Copy) and paste it here.

   {{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

*Submit:* the letter, the link, and a screenshot of your form. (Step 2
shows how.)

### Task 2 · Two test responses

Open your form with its link and send **two** test responses with
made-up names (for example *Test 1*, *Test 2*). Then open **Responses**.
(Step 3 shows how.)

*Submit:* a screenshot of the Responses tab that shows **2** responses.

### Task 3 · One letter

You add the question *Which size? Small, Medium, Large*. Which type? **A**
Text · **B** Choice · **C** Date
